name: Capture Studio — design tokens (exported from code for Figma import)
source: Exported from the Capture Studio Next.js + Tailwind codebase. Use with the html.to.design Figma plugin (import the running page), or create Figma styles from the values below.

shadows.record-button: large soft red glow (red-600 at 30% opacity)

components.name: Mode toggle (Video / Voice)
components.spec: 2-column segmented control; container white with zinc-200 border, radius 16, padding 4; active segment zinc-900 fill + white text + shadow; inactive zinc-500 text, hover zinc-100.

components.name: Help (?) button
components.spec: Outline circular icon button (40x40), opens modal dialog (max-width 28rem, radius 16) with title, description, and bullet list.

components.name: Sliders (Overlay opacity, Meter boost)
components.spec: Radix slider: 6px zinc-200 track, zinc-900 fill range, 20px white thumb with 2px zinc-900 border; numeric readout right-aligned tabular-nums.

components.name: Floating note window
components.spec: Semi-transparent dark glass panel (zinc-900, backdrop-blur-xl, white/25 border, radius 16) floating centered over stage; title bar with traffic-light dots + 'LIVE NOTE' label + close ×; editable textarea body; drag by panel, opacity 15–100% via slider.

components.name: Transport bar
components.spec: Bottom overlay gradient (black/70 → transparent); red pill Record/Stop button (48px height, radius full) + ghost 'Retry camera' button; mic level meter (112px track, white/20, emerald fill).

components.name: Takes library
components.spec: Responsive 2-col card grid; video takes render 16:9 player, voice takes render dark panel + audio element; footer row with metadata left, download + delete icon buttons right.
